title: Daemon comment names the real binary.hash writer
goal: crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs said binary.hash is written by 'susi admin sync (src/daemon/admin.rs)'; that command moved to commercial with T-DEVWF-1. Core writes the anchor itself, trust-on-first-use, in susi-sandbox-client's verify_binary_integrity. Comment-only, line-neutral.
results: Writer found by git grep: only crates/susi-sandbox-client/src/daemon_state/local.rs verify_binary_integrity writes binary.hash in core. Two comment lines in server.rs updated; line count unchanged.
